text:
sam: pushed a small observability tweak to the dashboard heatmap, opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/948 — can someone take a quick look? failing lint is blocking merge right now, @maria @kai

maria: on it, grabbing the PR. CI shows eslint in heatmap.tsx, might be a trivial unused-var

sam: here's the exact error from CI:
```
src/components/heatmap.tsx
  12:8  error  'unusedVar' is defined but never used  no-unused-vars
```

ci-bot: Build #2147 failed — eslint error in src/components/heatmap.tsx (see details: https://ci.internal/builds/2147) :warning:

maria: i'll push a tiny fix (remove unused var and update one snapshot) in a minute

maria: pushed fix -> force-pushed a commit that removes the unused var and bumps snapshot, PTAL https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/948/commits/3f2a

kai: i'm on PTO but checking from mobile — if maria pushed the lint fix and CI turns green, i'm fine with one approval and merge. if you want to be extra safe maybe wait for the canary window, but seems low-risk :+1:

maria: quick question — do we want to canary this change or just merge straight to main? it's a UI snapshot tweak only

sam: low-risk, no backend changes. let's merge once CI is green and we have one approval. tagging for today's EOD release window.

maria: approved :thumbsup:

kai: approving now (from mobile) — LGTM

ci-bot: Build #2147 succeeded — all checks passed :white_check_mark:

sam: merging now, thanks everyone :party-parrot:
